limitations: Descriptive service pairs; no population noninferiority or causal attribution from point differences.
Full-head parent was measured in the earlier stage; elapsed time and inherited caches may confound comparisons.
No gain resampling; unchanged prior numerical and quality evidence reused by identity.
Different free outputs are reported separately and are not strictly identical-work comparisons.
Previous long mixed/nonrepeat negative points and output differences remain part of the decision.
